question: At matched 10m charged node work, does batch-one signed external sampling improve the unchanged exact-river learner over the published batch-four signed control on the known medium/dry spot without degrading the known low/wet spot?
crossing: first complete target-0 then target-1 iteration at or above each label; charge exact uniform initialization and retain overshoot
training: six independent candidate paths, one per known spot and seed; same RNG seed within each control/candidate pair but batch sizes consume different random draws; no saved-policy warm start
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 exploitability divided by initial pot; lower is better
paired_metric: candidate B1 minus published control B4 at each matched work crossing for each seed; report all three final differences and median per known spot
diagnostics: both-seat additive saved-prefix best-response-loss contributions for preselected medium/dry exact turn rows 2443, 1596, 14 and all turn/river rows; report opponent and continuation assumptions; diagnostic only

decision.positive: at final 10m linear average B1 passes both spots' unchanged absolute gates, medium/dry paired median <= -0.001 initial pots and low/wet paired median <= +0.001
decision.negative: B1 fails any absolute gate, medium/dry paired median >= +0.001, or low/wet paired median > +0.001
decision.inconclusive: other complete outcome; failed source, compute or numerical gate stops with retained evidence

profile.forecast: for each of six candidate spot/seed paths take maximum of three complete construction-through-replay whole times scaled by 10m/actual work; sum these six maxima in fixed index-modulo-three worker partitions; T=max sum; require strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200

publication: prospective protocol before outcomes; isolated tested source with exact-source local base/optional/hooks/hosted qualification; publish and byte-verify synthetic proof, profile and separate compute admission before own candidate run; publish own raw candidate policies before comparison-only native audit; final exact-source checks
reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 comparison-only scalar audit of new candidate policies; published control's prior audit is reused by exact receipt; no reference strategy enters training
stop_rule: one fixed six-path matched-work candidate run against unchanged published B4 controls; retain complete/partial/failing results; no seed search, unfavorable retry, budget or threshold change, default promotion or unseen generalization claim
